en: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a woman in traditional dress standing on a path in the foreground. In the background is a prominent baroque-style church with two onion-domed towers, set amidst rolling green hills and scattered rural houses. There are leafless trees and the overall palette and printing style suggest an early colorized photograph. The top left corner contains the text 'Maria Trost bei Graz.'
